steps.gScale: The {gScale} starts on {g} and uses the same fingering as the {cScale}, with one change: {fSharp}, a black key, instead of {f}. The sharp at the start of the staff, the key signature, says so for the whole piece.
steps.up: The {gScale} going up. Finger 4 plays the black key.
steps.leftHand: Now with the left hand, starting on the {g} below middle {c}, with the same fingering as the left-hand {cScale}.
steps.inTime: Right hand, up and down in time.
